## ITemp type

Temporary per-update state carried on every `Ctx` instance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITemp = {
    isAnswer: boolean;
    session: Partial<ICacheRpc>;
    data: Partial<IPageData>;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};
```
**References:** [ICacheRpc](./gramstax.icacherpc.md)<!-- -->, [IPageData](./gramstax.ipagedata.md)

## Remarks

Flow pages read and write `temp` during dispatch; `isAnswer` marks whether the current step already produced a reply, `session` carries the decoded session RPC envelope, and `data` carries the decoded page-data envelope. Extra keys are free-form scratch space for handlers.

## Example


```ts
ctx.temp.isAnswer = true
ctx.temp[`attempt`] = 2
```
